_note: Railways (plan: project files steam_trains/plan.md). Placeholder numbers, Tim to tune. route: cost per world terrain code for laying track (m and w are impassable); bridge = river and water cells the track may cross; maxBridge = longest crossing in world units; reuse = cost factor on cells that already carry your track (branching); simplify = how far (world units) the drawn line may stray from the cell path; smooth = corner-rounding passes; clearance and minRadius: see _clearance.

route._clearance: Tim 2026-11-07: track keeps clearance world units (one town cell) from mountains and other impassable cells, in the world and in towns; minRadius = tightest curve in world units (corners are rounded to arcs, no hairpins)

link._note: placeholder, Tim to tune. A link is the whole track between two stations and always takes seconds to lay, whatever its length; paid a stretch at a time from the ordering town's stock (costPer100 per 100 units of track; waits when the stock runs short); minTier = town hall tier a town needs before it can link; maxBuilding = links one clan may lay at once.

gang._note: placeholder: the rail gang drawn at the railhead (laborers; real units only near someone on the island, like town workers). hammerSeconds = how long they work in place before walking up to the railhead again; anim = rail_worker = laborer body holding a sledge (tools/export_sprites.mjs ITEMS); work clip hammer = Great Sword Slash swing.

train._note: placeholder, Tim to tune. Each open link gets one train (stand-in until stations build them): it runs station to station and back at speed (world units a second; the hero runs at 6), waiting stopSeconds at each end (Tim 2026-11-07: 60, long enough to walk over and board). cars = carriages and wagons behind the engine; gap = world units from one car's middle to the next (engine first). viewSpeed (Tim 2026-11-07) = its speed while someone rides it or a player hero is within viewRange of the engine (a little under a horse, 22.5); with nobody near it runs at speed, so arrival times hold.
train._consist: Tim 2026-11-07: the cars behind the engine and tender, front to back: carriage (8 seats each, ride.seatsPerCar), goods (goods wagon), guard (brake van). Drawn from the train_* sprites; replaces cars and gap where set.

ride._note: placeholder, Tim to tune (train plan step 4). Board at a station while the train stands there: you and your followers (within followRange) ride, and every standing Hero group crew within heroGroupRange, following or not (Tim 2026-11-07); seatsPerCar = riders per carriage (the engine, tender and last wagon carry none). The train leaves departSeconds after you board. skipSeconds = how long you ride before Skip takes you straight to the far station. The capital end lands you just inside the island gate. reach = how close to a town's station you must stand.
ride._boarding: Tim 2026-11-08: picking a train calls All aboard: a zone of zoneRadius on the ground round the station for callSeconds, or until the train leaves if sooner; everyone of yours in it then gets on, Space again boards at once. followRange and heroGroupRange are no longer used.
